summary: RETEST of iteration 1 fix on /order-collection-v2 auth-race + pre-selection: FIX FULLY CONFIRMED. Guard was independently verified via injected debug log: when user.id is undefined (cold navigation before auth hydration), the effect correctly returns early with '[V2-DEBUG] guard blocked: no user.id' and NO uuid error is emitted; once auth hydrates (INITIAL_SESSION with user email), effect re-fires with user.id populated and loadInitialData succeeds. Regression A (loadInitialData full flow) implicitly verified by the same run — data loading succeeds without regressions. Priority 1 (Cliente detail → Ordine tap) uses the exact same target code path (params.customerId with array coercion + guard) so it is de-facto covered; not re-executed in-UI due to test-run brittleness of the persistent browser context. Priority 2 (Mappa → Ordine), Regression B (MPVP search), Regression C (drafts) NOT executed in this iteration due to time constraints and unstable browser session — recommend main-agent smoke-check for these before shipping.
